items.title: Razorpay webhooks failing signature verification
items.summary: Razorpay webhook processing failed: an expired webhook signing secret rotation on Acme's side caused signature verification to fail, so payments succeeded at Razorpay but invoices stayed 'open' in Acme and dunning emails went out to end customers who had already paid. Resolved after 215 minutes; follow-ups are tracked in RB-002.

items.title: Invoice PDF renderer out of memory
items.summary: Invoice PDF renderer workers ran out of memory after a fonts package update; PDFs came out blank or failed with 'Rendering timed out', and invoice emails were sent without attachments. Resolved after 105 minutes; follow-ups are tracked in RB-003.

items.title: Transactional email delayed by provider throttling
items.summary: The transactional email provider throttled Acme's sending IP pool; invoice and reminder emails were delayed by 2-5 hours (none lost) and some customers saw them arrive late. Resolved after 330 minutes; follow-ups are tracked in RB-005.
